questions.prompt: New GTA 6 gameplay just dropped and fans are stunned — the city's alive on screen tonight and everyone's talking about it. Which scene sounds most like yours right now?

options.text: Already rewatching every clip — I'm in the city the moment it opens.
Sitting with it, letting the new streets sink in slow.
My head's bouncing from clip to clip — too much to take in at once.
Watching it through once, steady — saving the rush for later.

questions.prompt: There's a tunic in Ocarina of Time that lets you breathe underwater — and getting it means diving deep into Hyrule's waters tonight. When the deep water calls, where does it pull you?

options.text: Straight down — I've got the route mapped and I'm going for it.
Easing in slow — the water's not going anywhere tonight.
Drifting with the current — the lake decides where tonight goes.
Standing at the edge, head full of 'what if I miss something?'

questions.prompt: A fighting-game legend just said he wishes weaker consoles like the Xbox Series S didn't exist — the hardware holds the games back. Tonight, a game you love is running rough because the box can't keep up. What do you do?

options.text: Play through it anyway — the game's worth the rough edges.
Wait it out — I'll play it properly when I can.
Vent about it first — the hardware had one job.
Shrug and switch off — tonight's not a fight-the-box night.

questions.prompt: Dua Lipa, Tame Impala, and SZA are headlining Coachella 2027 — the lineup just dropped and the desert night is calling. If someone handled the festival-night drink for you, what would you want in your hand tonight?

options.text: A cold lemonade — sweet, slow, and made for the desert air.
Something sparkling and cold — easy sipping while the sun goes down.
Virgin or hard — a Moscow mule hits just right tonight.
Just water, I don't need anything else tonight.

questions.prompt: Rings of Power season 3 is showing where the rings are — old magic waking up across Middle-earth tonight. Which sound is the sound of that world opening up for you?

options.text: A low, swelling score — the mountains and the forests breathing.
Friends talking it over — the lore's better when it's shared.
Just the night air — no music, only the world itself.
Deep drums and a rising pulse — the rings are calling and I'm answering.

questions.prompt: Avengers: Doomsday is coming — the trailer, the cast, the date, all lining up tonight. The next hour is yours before the big reveal lands. What should it feel like?

options.text: Counting down loud — the reveal can't come fast enough.
Steady and ready — I've waited this long, one more hour is easy.
Wandering easy — the hour's mine, the trailer can wait.
Restless — too many theories, too many trailers to rewatch.
